overview: Streaming path as above for the 1-hour view; hourly/daily Spark jobs compute exact counts for longer windows.

estimation.assumption: Illustrative stream: 1M events/s and 60 one-second buckets.
estimation.calculation: 1,000,000 × 60 = 60M events per minute if retained individually.
estimation.result: Sketches bound counter memory independently of distinct item count, with approximation cost.
estimation.implication: Choose sketch error/confidence and window granularity explicitly; retain raw data for exact historical repair.

entityDetails.purpose: Materialized top-K serving state for a completed or live window.
accessPatterns: Read top items for a chosen window; atomically publish a new result version.
constraints: Approximate candidates need an error/recall policy; mergeable count sketches do not guarantee a globally heavy item appears in every local top-K.

apiDetails.purpose: Record an event for windowed popularity.
apiDetails.rationale: Dedup event IDs within the policy window; separate event time from processing time.
Expose window and approximation/freshness semantics; do not recompute a global sort on every query.

failureCases.scenario: Late events arrive after a window was published
failureCases.handling: Use a watermark and an allowed-lateness policy; publish corrected window versions if supported. Keep approximate live and exact batch outputs distinguishable.

alternatives: Use sketches for bounded-memory approximate live trends. Add exact batch recomputation for settled historical windows when accuracy justifies a second pipeline; expose approximation and output-version metadata.
